title: Units of measure: unit picker for a unit-code field and a quantity's unit field (ADR-0158 Open item 8)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (L1 S2 of seat repo:objectstack#5 on PR #37449, verdict 7185332286; contract record 7185313489). Split out of #35490 so its PR can land the label rendering while the picker stays carried.

Grading: `area:data` · reach: write — ADR-0158 Open item 8 (ruled A on #35339, record 7008524997: a standalone unit field renders with its label 「有下拉」, i.e. gets a picker) names #35490 as the picker card; PR #37449 draws the unit label in cells and stops there · evidence: read — no unit dropdown exists for a `code`-mode unit field or for a quantity's `unitField`, and on the form face `TextField` does not read `unitConfig`, so a unit-code field in a form shows the bare code (even read-only).
Suggested-grade: p2 · same grade as the parent; the ruled OI8 consequence is unbuilt.

## What

- A unit picker on the form face for a field declaring `unitConfig` with `unitMode: 'code'`, and for the `unitField` of a quantity: options from the standard-unit catalog plus the organization's own units, labelled by the server-translated name (`app.messages.standardUnit<CODE>`, falling back to the spec English base name), storing the code.
- Read-only form face shows the label, not the bare code.
- Pins: picker lists the catalog, stores the code, shows the translated label; read-only form shows the label.

Related: #35490 (PR #37449), ADR-0158 Open item 8.
Dedupe: searched open issues for 'unit picker' — none.
